subject: API-Football team 195 (Willem II) in competition 89
claim: Willem II is the proper name of the Tilburg club's first team (named after King William II of the Netherlands). The Roman numeral is part of the club name and does not mark a reserve side.
observations: API-Football lists team 195 as 'Willem II' in league 88 (Eredivisie) and league 89 (Eerste Divisie); the formal alias table already binds 荷甲 195 to 威廉二世 (auto_verified).
The football-data.co.uk name 'Willem II' and the football-data.org team 672 'Willem II Tilburg' are bound to the same stored team 威廉二世.

JC official team 257 (威廉二世) played 11 official 荷乙 fixtures in the last twelve months (2025-11-07 to 2026-05-23); in every one a provider fixture with team 195 on the same side exists within three hours.
The club played the 2025-26 season in the Eerste Divisie and plays 2026-27 in the Eredivisie; the owner confirmed on 2026-11-18 that it is registered as a first team.
